card: Backports eight pull requests to the 32.x release branch (#36277, #36303, #36404, #36435, #36340, #36392, #36462, #36471). Fixes include ensuring private broadcast completes all three initial outbound connections and handles retry disconnects correctly, capping Sock::WaitMany timeout so bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0 works on macOS and BSD systems, correcting bitcoin-util genesis hash byte order, and adjusting OpenRPC hex schema patterns. It also resolves CI container subnet collisions and test harness shutdown issues.
changed_since_previous: Added backports of #36462 (allowing empty strings in the OpenRPC hex schema pattern) and #36471 (formatting the genesis block hash in display order in bitcoin-util).
evidence: Commit db5b315955: 'bitcoin-cli turns -rpcclienttimeout=0 into a 5 year timeout and passes it down to Sock::Wait... on macOS and the BSDs the wait is done with select(), which fails with EINVAL for timeouts above 10^8 seconds on macOS.'

Commit 3c61fa20ef: 'net: always complete all initial private broadcast connections... Prevent additional stale retry connections by tracking disconnects and explicitly granting new connections with TryGrantRetry.'
Commit d66ea38afc: 'rpc: Fix OpenRPC hex pattern to allow empty strings'
Commit 101719cb43: 'bitcoin-util: print genesis hash in display order'
problem: The 32.x branch lacks several fixes merged to master: private broadcast can fail to finish its initial three connections or launch stale retries; `bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0` fails on macOS/BSD because `select()` returns `EINVAL` on timeouts exceeding 10^8 seconds; `bitcoin-util` displays the genesis block hash byte-reversed; OpenRPC regex rejects valid empty hex strings; and concurrent containerized CI jobs collide on Docker subnets.

risk.why: Mistakes in private broadcast connection handling could leak broadcast topology or fail to transmit user transactions across the P2P network.

scope_notes: A backport batch consisting of 11 cherry-picked commits from 8 PRs merged to master.
summary: Backports eight merged pull requests to the 32.x release branch: #36277, #36303, #36404, #36435, #36340, #36392, #36462, and #36471. Changes include completing initial private broadcast connections and preventing stale retries, capping socket wait timeouts to fix `-rpcclienttimeout=0` on macOS and BSD, permitting empty hex strings in OpenRPC schema definitions, printing genesis block hashes in display order in `bitcoin-util`, and various CI and test suite fixes.
